target: local Apple M4 (G16G), 10 GPU cores, macOS 26.6.2 (25G82)
boundary: public Metal API only; runtime MSL compile of our own carrier kernel; binary-archive splice of our own hand-assembled AGX programs (tools/agx-isa isadb.assemble()); owned shared buffers; every case a fresh process; no Apple binary, archive, BO, or command-stream inspection beyond our own compiled/assembled bytes
hypothesis_origin: apple9_isa_explainer.md (external compiler engineer's public-to-us document, treated as a third-party hypothesis source per CLAUDE.md, PUBLIC clean-room category) -- tested here, never ported: every byte executed is assembled from our own field values via tools/agx-isa isadb.assemble()

raw_schema.00_env.json: environment/provenance receipt (informational git_revision NEVER gated on -- pinned_revision above + authored_*_sha256 are what matters)
raw_schema.01_results.jsonl: GATED, byte-compared-across-runs: one JSON object per case with keys i,name,group,oracle,expect_match,notes,status,pipeline_source,out_hex,observed,match -- no nondeterministic field
raw_schema.01_timing.jsonl: NON-GATED sibling: one JSON object per case with keys i,duration_ms,argv,stdout,stderr -- explicitly NOT required to match across runs
raw_schema.02_dispatch.json: run summary: n_cases, status_counts, match_counts, results_sha256, code hashes
raw_schema.STOP.json: written on any pre-capture or capture-time stop; raw/ left absent if pre-capture

hypothesis_to_group_map.H2: SRCA_PAIR/SRCB_PAIR word4 (the LATER-read oracle, crossed against the register-field top bit)
hypothesis_to_group_map.H3: answered by reasoning from H1's own result, not a separate group -- see PRE_REGISTRATION.md section 5
hypothesis_to_group_map.H6: answered via db.json structural analysis, not a hardware group -- see PRE_REGISTRATION.md section 5

confirm_vs_refute.H1: CONFIRMS current db.json 7-bit-index model if srcA_reg/srcB_reg field value 67 reads 0.0; CONFIRMS explainer's 6-bit-address model if it reads 30.0 (V_LOW); REFUTES BOTH if neither.
confirm_vs_refute.H2: CONFIRMS the complementary-pair model if the later reader's result depends jointly on (bit15,bit19)/(bit31,bit20); REFUTES it (single-bit model stands) if the later reader depends on bit19/bit20 alone, identically across both register-field top-bit values.
confirm_vs_refute.H4: CONFIRMS the route hypothesis if exactly one of the 8 ROUTE_LOAD cases reads V_LOAD correctly while ROUTE_ALU controls all match; REFUTES it if all 8 ROUTE_LOAD cases mismatch identically while ROUTE_ALU controls all match (blocker persists, route is not the fix).
confirm_vs_refute.H5: CONFIRMS a candidate fix if that specific GPR_MOVE_RETRY variant matches its oracle while move_baseline_fail_replicate does not; REFUTES all three candidates if all four (incl. baseline) mismatch identically.

oracle_source: casematrix.py build_cases() -- pure Python, computed independently of any GPU run, using isadb.imm_encode/imm_decode for the minifloat immediate domain (H.imm_value(), a fixed point of that codec) and the EXP-0090 HW-validated device_load/device_store address formulas
clean_room: OWN-SHADER + HW-PROBE + PUBLIC. Every byte executed is either our own hand-assembled instruction sequence (tools/agx-isa isadb.assemble()) or the compiled form of our own carrier MSL (tools/shdump). apple9_isa_explainer.md is cited as the hypothesis origin (PUBLIC) and never ported verbatim -- no GLSL source from that document appears anywhere in this experiment's kernels/ or code. No Apple binary introspected.
